# Draft:Amaziah's Battle of Edom

----
In the books of Kings and Chronicles, King Amaziah of Judah attacked and defeated the Edomites, seizing Selah, although they never subdued Edom completely. He employed a large mercenary army for 100 talents, as well as 300.000 Judean soldiers.
Backround
Amaziah's great-grandfather Jehoram lost control over Edom due to its rebellion, Amaziah sought to reconquer it.
